content.title: How to Read Seerah?
content.subtitle: Not sure how to benefit from this vast ocean of knowledge?
content.body:
Want to start reading Seerah but not sure which book to begin with, what to read next, or how to gradually move from the basics to deeper study?

And beyond simply remembering events and dates, have you ever wondered how to understand the life of Rasulullah ﷺ in a way that helps you draw meaningful lessons for your own life?

That is exactly what we will explore in a special webinar for Muslims Day Ansar members: “How to Read Seerah?” (in Bengali language)

Session Details

Saturday, September 26, 2026 | 9:00 PM Bangladesh Time

Our speaker will be Muhtaram Kabir Anwar (Hafizahullah), an engineering graduate from BUET and a corporate trainer. He currently works extensively on Seerah, Islamic history, and leadership, career, and personal development through the lens of Seerah.

He also shares significant Seerah events with Hajj and Umrah pilgrims during their journeys.

He is the founder of Itqaan Institute.

What will you learn?

• How to start studying Seerah from the very beginning
• How to progress from Beginner to Intermediate and Advanced levels
• How to choose reliable books and authentic sources
• Which books to read first and what to read next
• How to go beyond simply knowing an event and understand its context, decisions, and outcomes
• How to draw lessons from the decisions of Rasulullah ﷺ and apply them to our lives today

In other words, the goal is not simply to give you a list of Seerah books, but to help you develop a structured roadmap and a deeper perspective for studying Seerah.

Ansar members will also have an exclusive opportunity to join the session live on Zoom and ask the speaker their questions directly at the end of the session. The webinar will also be livestreamed publicly on Facebook.

Will you join us on this journey?

Muslims Day is not just about building an app. Our next mission is to reach 10 million people through beneficial Islamic content and services and help more people become better Muslims.

Today, 613 Ansars are already standing with us in this mission.

Our goal is to build a community of 2,000 Ansars—meaning we are looking for 1,387 more people who are willing to support this mission and be part of the journey.

If you want to go beyond simply using Muslims Day and become a supporter of this mission, you can become an Ansar too.

Your journey may begin with a single webinar—but it can also be your first step toward becoming part of something much bigger.

InshaAllah, Ansar members will receive the Zoom link for the webinar by email.
